metadata.notes: Sol owns public/safety contracts, plans, integration, commits, and closure. Terra implements one bounded ready item at a time. Actual model_override is recorded only when dispatched.

status_rules.ready_rule: Dependencies are complete, the owning slice is ready, and required inputs exist.
status_rules.complete_rule: Acceptance, verification, evidence, and result contain concrete proof.
status_rules.repair_rule: Repair the smallest failed item or add a focused repair item before broadening scope.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not delete, skip, or weaken tests to make an item pass.
Do not change existing CLI stdout or TUI Enter/Esc defaults without updating and re-reviewing the plan.
Do not launch real external applications in automated validation.
Do not write FileList outside isolated fixtures during automated validation.
Do not let Terra change public/safety contracts; stop and return to Sol when a contract change is required.
Do not mark an item complete without evidence.

items.result: UI-state writes now enqueue to a coalescing worker using crash-released OS sidecar locks and latest-read JSON leaf merges; ordered history deltas preserve concurrent writers and unknown fields, while public root/history read plus async history enqueue/flush APIs support later CLI/TUI adapters.
